desc: This particularly atmospheric subgenre is considered the first metal subgenre, as it can be traced back directly to Black Sabbath, who is widely considered to be the first heavy metal band. Doom Metal features slow tempos, thick guitar distortion, and an ominous or dreadful atmosphere. Doom Metal songs also tend to be quite long, frequently reaching 10 minutes or more. Some notable Doom Metal bands are Black Sabbath, Pentagram, Saint Vitus, Trouble, Candlemass, and Witchfinder General.
